name: B10-0161/2024 (S&D) – EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for tougher action against Russia's "shadow fleet" — old, often uninsured oil tankers Russia uses to sell oil and get around EU sanctions. It wants a full ban on Russian oil and gas imports, sanctions on the ships and their owners, and closer tracking of these vessels, which it says risk oil spills in European waters. It also urges EU countries to enforce sanctions strictly and the G7 to tighten the oil price cap. This is a set of requests, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks for new sanctions, a full Russian fuel import ban and ship tracking.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, shipowners, oil traders, and Baltic coastal communities facing spill risks.
- **What happens next:** The requests go to the EU Commission, Council and member states, which decide on new measures.
